newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes Aviation March load factor down.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes Aviation March load factor down.

text.p: Great Lakes Aviation Ltd said Friday its passenger load factor fell to 43.9 percent in March from 46.2 percent a year ago.
Revenue passenger miles in the month were 24.5 million, down from 25.3 million a year ago, with available seat miles at 55.8 million, up from 54.7 million, the company said.

For the year through March, load factor was 41.4, down from 43.4 percent a year ago, the company said. Revenue passenger miles were 64.3 million, down from 65.9 million a year ago and available seat miles were 155.0 million, up from 151.9 million.

The regional airline said that though revenue passenger miles for the month declined, preliminary estimates indicate overall passenger and public service revenues increased by 10.3 percent over the prior year as a result of a strengthening of yields and increased subsidy rates provided by the Department of Transportation.
Great Lakes shares rose 1/8 to 1-1/4 Friday.
